t: Duckhams 5W-30 engine oil is a fully synthetic, high performance lubricant designed for modern passenger car engines. Suitable for mechanics and vehicle technicians working on a range of petrol and diesel vehicles, it is formulated with advanced additive technology, and meets ACEA C3 specifications. A low-SAPS formulation provides robust wear protection and supports the efficiency of emission systems. It also aids in promoting fuel economy and ensures quick oil circulation during cold starts, which is crucial for engine longevity.
